title: File Walker Security
description: Understanding how the walker ensures secure file access with allowlist and size limits.

steps.title: Security Constants
steps.description: The walker package defines a 10MB max file size limit to prevent reading excessively large files into memory.

steps.title: Allowed Extensions
steps.description: Only specific file extensions are allowed for security. This prevent reading sensitive files like .env, .ssh keys, or system files.

steps.title: Walker Structure
steps.description: The Walker struct holds the root path for file operations and tracks the last audit message for logging.
